NPC-HUD mockups 5: the bottom of the screen

1. The one-page NPC sheet2 to 4. The HUD5. The bottom of the screen

The whole screen at 1600 x 900, scaled to this page. The HUD runs across the bottom, from the left edge to the sidebar. The hotbar is the two short rows at the HUD's right end; the players list sits above the HUD's left end, closed by default. The map, the scene controls, the carousel and the chat are stand-ins; the Turn dock (above the chat's input) and the pick bar are the system's real ones.

5c. A choice on the map: the HUD asks the question Picked by Lucas

Redrawn after Lucas's review (2026-11-12: the first version replaced the whole HUD with a stretched bar and looked broken). The HUD keeps its frame: who is asking on the left, the hotbar on the right. Only the middle (the Quick row and the categories, which can't be used while a roll waits) becomes the pick bar's question and buttons, with a gold glow; it comes back when the choice is made.
